description: Returns the link where a person can book a meeting with MEOM (HubSpot Meetings), the contact page URL and the sales email address. This tool does not book anything or send any data; the person opens the link themselves. Optionally pass a service id from list-services to get that service's own booking link, if it has one.

lang.description: Content language: "fi" (Finnish, default) or "en" (English). Not every page has an English version.

service.description: Optional service id from list-services, e.g. "geo-optimointi-verkkosivustoille".

name: meom-public-get-booking-link
title: Get MEOM meeting booking link
